title: Raku Spooktacular
evidence_sentence: The page announces a Raku Spooktacular event held in-person at Brackers on October 30.
evidence_quote: We are planning a special afternoon/evening edition of this popular event on Wednesday October 30 from (roughly) 4:00pm-9:00pm
summary: A raku firing event held at Brackers on a single afternoon and evening in October 2019. The page provides limited details on registration or participation.
